# homecareOS

> homecareOS is the complete operating system for UK home care agencies. Free for up to 5 staff and 25 service users; £7-10/staff/month above that. Built specifically for the four UK regulators: CQC (England), CIW (Wales), Care Inspectorate (Scotland) and RQIA (Northern Ireland).

Most home care software charges £15-30/staff/month per user. homecareOS is free for small agencies and £7-10/staff/month for larger ones — funded by adjacent services (VoIP, invoice financing, earned wage access for carers, training marketplace) rather than agency licence fees.

## What homecareOS includes (12 core modules + 2 stakeholder portals)

- **Scheduling & Rota** — Visual drag-and-drop rota with real-time availability, run templates, colour-coded visit blocks, GPS visit verification
- **AI Rota Builder** (Pro) — Optimal rotas in seconds based on availability, distance, qualifications, continuity of care
- **Carer Mobile App** — iOS + Android with full offline mode, GPS check-in/out, eMAR, body maps, observations, holiday requests
- **Digital Care Records** — Person-centred care plans, eMAR, observations, outcome-focused goals, immutable audit trail
- **Compliance & Regulation** — CQC/CIW/Care Inspectorate/RQIA frameworks built in, PIR auto-population, incident management, training expiry alerts
- **Staff Management** — Bradford Factor calculation (S² × D), absence tracking, supervisions, training records, DBS expiry
- **Recruitment** — Multi-step applicant flow, document collection, references, DBS verification
- **Finance & Billing** — Payer/service/rate band model, four-value time billing, invoice generation, payroll exports
- **Reporting & Analytics** — Eight report types, KPI dashboards, custom queries
- **Phone System & Comms** (VoIP on Pro) — UK number in browser, IVR routing, voicemail transcription, two-way SMS, on-call mobile diversion
- **UK Policy Library** — 140+ pre-built care policies with version control, staff acknowledgements, auto-update on regulation change
- **Stock, PPE, Kit & Vehicles** — PPE inventory with reorder thresholds, vehicle MOT alerts, supplier order log
- **Family & Service User Portal** (free, all plans) — Real-time visit notifications, carer profiles, care notes access, direct messaging
- **Commissioner Portal** (free, all plans) — Outcome dashboards, KPI tracking, audit trails for local authorities and NHS commissioners

## Pricing

- **Free**: Up to 5 staff and 25 service users — full core features, no credit card, no time limit
- **Start**: £7/staff/month — unlimited staff and service users
- **Pro**: £10/staff/month — adds AI Rota Builder, advanced analytics & exports, white-label, third-party API
- 20% saving on annual billing

## Key differentiators (vs UK home care software market)

- **Free tier with full features** — most competitors charge from day one or have severely crippled free plans
- **Built specifically for UK** — not adapted from US/AU; supports all four UK regulators natively from day one
- **AI cover finder** — automatic carer scoring for last-minute cover (distance/continuity/hours/preference/schedule)
- **Bradford Factor** — automatic absence-pattern scoring with traffic-light alerts
- **Full offline carer app** — works in basement flats and rural areas
- **Family portal included** — most competitors charge extra
- **VoIP phone system embedded** — UK number in browser, IVR, voicemail transcription
- **140+ UK care policies** — pre-built, version-controlled, auto-updating
- **Earned wage access for carers** — staff retention tool
